Requests from providers must be documented on the Provider Input Form . Please download and complete the form, then email the completed form to shp.health.services@securityhealth.org . We appreciate your input. To receive payment, providers must meet all policy criteria outlined for the specific service provided . Please review the below list of medical policies and request a copy of the policies for any procedures you perform in your office. Security Health Plan medical policies are updated monthly. To review the medical policy changes go to the Medical Policies webpage in the provider manual. Security Health Plan uses InterQual® Transparency Tool to assist with medical decision-making Security Health Plan uses the InterQual® Transparency Tool as part of the utilization management process to provide enhanced clinical detail during the review process. This tool allows for consideration of an individual patient’s severity of illness, comorbidities and complications during the review process in real-time. To learn more go to Change Healthcare (part of Optum®) and follow these steps: 1. Create a One Healthcare ID. 2. Once logged in, you can select the subsets from the drop-down menu. 3. Under product, select the appropriate subsets: LOC: Acute Pediatric, CP: Imaging, etc. For more information, read the article "View clinical content used by Security Health Plan for medical decision-making with the InterQual® Transparency Tool" in the Provider Portal .
